title: Bubble.
headings: **Now, how can you go from playing to mastering** *quickly***?**
coverage: opening + one cue-ranked passage + headings; partial inspection

passages.text: ChatGPT had just come out. Viral sensation. So you tried it.
*“Study how I write. The rhythm, the word choices, the structure. Now write a first draft on [your topic] in my voice. Not an AI voice. Mine.”*
